_metadata.description: EM's own migration to the react-vite template contract: validation gates, screaming architecture, CLI manifest/measures, proto conventions, and the per-domain Connect-RPC migration (OT-P0-005, OT-P1-001).

requirements.title: Requirements registry conforms to the template contract
requirements.description: requirements/index.json is a thin imports-only registry over per-target module files, every prd_ref matches a PRD operational target, and the test-genie business phase discovers and validates the registry without findings.

validation.notes: Evidence: test-genie business phase green with >0 modules discovered (vrooli scenario test ecosystem-manager business).

requirements.title: Screaming architecture by domain
requirements.description: Business logic lives in api/internal/<domain>/, UI features under ui/src/features/<domain>/, CLI commands under cli/domains/<domain>/; cross-domain code goes through seams declared in docs/internal/SEAMS.md.

validation.notes: Evidence: test-genie structure phase green after the domain reorg, verified by the screaming-architecture-audit skill.

requirements.title: CLI manifest with measures coverage
requirements.description: cli/manifest.json declares every domain's commands on proto-first bindings, and every stateful domain declares a measure or an explicit waiver so the test-genie measures phase passes.

validation.notes: Evidence: test-genie measures phase green (measures-health validate scenario ecosystem-manager reports no uncovered domains).

requirements.title: Proto packages follow the fleet convention
requirements.description: Every proto file under packages/proto/schemas/ecosystem-manager/ uses the vrooli.ecosystem_manager.v1.<domain> package convention with per-domain go_package, and shared types live in their canonical locations.

validation.notes: Evidence: test-genie proto phase green (no package_mismatch or shared_type_misplaced errors).

requirements.title: Discovery is the Connect-RPC reference domain
requirements.description: The discovery domain serves a proto-defined DiscoveryService over Connect-RPC end-to-end (proto schema, generated handlers, generated clients), demonstrating the migration shape for the remaining domains.

requirements.title: Remaining domains migrate to Connect-RPC per-domain
requirements.description: The seven REST domains (tasks, queue, autosteer, settings, prompts, insights, skills/importance) gain proto service definitions and Connect handlers/clients, one domain at a time per docs/internal/MIGRATION-GUIDE.md, with no REST/Connect coexistence within a migrated domain.

validation.notes: Evidence: per-domain Connect tests + green contracts/proto phases after each domain migration (docs/internal/MIGRATION-GUIDE.md).
